$comment: Shared VfFieldset cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. The fieldset owns no interaction: every case is static, and a case whose body holds consumer controls declares consumerInteractive, the number of focusable controls the consumer put there, so a control the component itself grew still fails when every target grows it. The scoped default slot (describedBy, invalid) is a Vue mechanism with no Razor counterpart; no case binds it - see outsideTheCatalog in the policy. VfGroupBox has no cases here and must not be given any.

propVocabulary.label: string, default undefined. Opens the legend by JavaScript truthiness: "" is none, "0" is one.
propVocabulary.description: string, default undefined. Opens the description paragraph and its id in aria-describedby.
propVocabulary.error: string, default undefined. Opens the error paragraph, its id in aria-describedby, and the invalid modifier.
propVocabulary.invalid: boolean, default false. The invalid modifier only.

slotVocabulary.label: Replaces the label prop; counts by presence, so a slot that renders nothing shows the prop text.
slotVocabulary.description: As label, for the description paragraph.
slotVocabulary.error: As label, for the error paragraph; also invalid by presence.
slotVocabulary.body: The default slot, inside div.vf-fieldset__control. text, or controls: input-and-button (a labelled text input and a button) or radios (two labelled radio inputs).

cases.title: A bare fieldset: no legend, no paragraphs, no aria-describedby, the control wrapper alone
No default slot either: the control wrapper still renders, empty
A label prop: a classed legend with plain text, no span, no id, no aria-labelledby
An empty label is no label: no legend at all
The label "0" is a label, as JavaScript reads it
A label slot alone opens the legend with rich content
A label slot replaces the label prop
A label slot that renders nothing counts, and the prop is its fallback text
A label slot that renders nothing with no prop: an empty legend
A description prop: a classed paragraph after the control wrapper, named by the fieldset

props.description: We ship to the address on file.

cases.title: An empty description is none: no paragraph and no aria-describedby
A description slot alone, with rich content, is named by the fieldset
A description slot that renders nothing falls back to the prop text
An error prop: a classed paragraph named by the fieldset and the invalid modifier, with no role and no aria-invalid
An empty error is none: no paragraph, no modifier
The error "0" is an error, and so invalid
An error slot alone opens the paragraph and the invalid state
An error slot that renders nothing: an empty named paragraph, and still invalid
invalid alone: the modifier and nothing else - no error paragraph, no aria-describedby, no aria-invalid
An error is invalid even with invalid explicitly false
Description first, then error, in the fieldset aria-describedby
Label, description and error slots alone
Every part with real consumer controls inside: the controls are the consumer's, the fieldset owns none

props.label: Contact
props.description: We only use this to reach you.

cases.title: A radio group: the native grouping the fieldset exists for
A native disabled fieldset disables every nested control: disabled stays a fieldset attribute
form and name reach the fieldset as native attributes
Consumer class, style, id and data attributes land on the fieldset after the canonical classes
A consumer aria-describedby replaces the computed one
A consumer aria-describedby is forwarded when the fieldset computed none
A consumer that explicitly passes aria-describedby as nothing replaces the computed value: the fieldset names nothing although it renders a description and an error
A consumer role, aria-invalid and accessible name pass through unchanged; the fieldset writes none of them
Two fieldsets side by side: each names only its own paragraphs
Label, description and error text is escaped
A titled fieldset around plain content - the shape VfGroupBox also renders, which this one must not become
